finalText:
**Big: ~1290 hits in 94 files. Only about 940 are safely renamable.**

Four zones must keep `account_id`:

| Zone | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public contract, frozen, needs a new dated version |
| `lib/serialize.js` `WIRE` values | 1 | Right side is the wire name clients read |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk` | 20 | Generated, `npm run vendor:refresh` overwrites |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 61 | Applied in prod, editing rewrites history |

Also the ~250 in-SQL hits in `services/**/repo/*.js` name the real DB column. They only move after a real column-rename migration.

Sign-off call: rename JS locals, params, and object keys inside `services`. Keep DB column, wire name, vendor, and migrations. That splits it into two changes, not one.
